scope: V=9 costs 92 bits and overruns - evidence that EVERY field up to the landing index is decoded, not just the landing one

measurement_idx8.note: the block consumed the whole buffer (1400 bits = 175 bytes) and overran

hypothesis.statement: the delta decoder decodes EVERY field from index 0 up to the landing index; only fields beyond the landing index are copy-only
support: V=1 (landing 0) consumed ~45 bits in the ps section for a single field, far more than one codec read
V=9 (landing 8) consumed 92 bits ~ 9 fields x ~10 bits
so the cost scales with the landing index, which is exactly what 'decode all fields up to the landing point' predicts
